d:
Estrilda targets a tile and charges across the battlefield toward it three times, each time along a different [[straight path]]. Each of the first two charges deals [[240%]]{atk} damage to enemies in her path and stuns them for [[2]]s. The final charge goes from the enemy [[edge of the battlefield|battlefield-edge]] to the allied [[edge of the battlefield|battlefield-edge]], dealing [[360%]]{atk} damage to enemies in her path and stunning them for [[3]]s. Estrilda is [[invincible|invincible]] during these charges.
After the skill ends, Estrilda leaps to the allied [[edge of the battlefield|battlefield-edge]], landing on the tile whose axis line covers the most enemies, and casts Ride Down.
Increases the damage of each of the first two charges to [[260%]]{atk} and the final charge to [[390%]]{atk}.
Increases the damage of each of the first two charges to [[280%]]{atk} and the final charge to [[420%]]{atk}.
Increases the damage of each of the first two charges to [[300%]]{atk} and the final charge to [[450%]]{atk}.
Increases the damage of each of the first two charges to [[320%]]{atk} and the final charge to [[480%]]{atk}.

When a battle starts, Estrilda casts Ride Down.
Ride Down: After a brief wind-up, Estrilda charges to the enemy [[edge of the battlefield|battlefield-edge]], dealing [[220%]]{atk} damage to enemies in her path. She pushes the first enemy she strikes forward along her path. If she collides with another enemy, she switches targets and pushes the new enemy instead, continuing until she reaches the edge. The enemy pushed to the edge is knocked into the air, taking [[320%]]{atk} extra damage before being knocked down for [[3]]s. Estrilda remains [[unaffected|unaffected]] throughout the process.
Active. Estrilda sweeps her lance, dealing [[180%]]{atk} damage to adjacent enemies.
Increases Ride Down's damage to enemies in the path to [[240%]]{atk} and the lance sweep's damage to [[200%]]{atk}.
Increases Ride Down's damage to enemies in the path to [[260%]]{atk} and the lance sweep's damage to [[220%]]{atk}.
Increases Ride Down's damage to enemies in the path to [[280%]]{atk} and the lance sweep's damage to [[240%]]{atk}.

Estrilda unleashes a rapid series of lance strikes against an enemy, dealing [[40%]]{atk} damage [[7]] times and reducing their ATK by [[30%]] for [[12]]s. If she is at the enemy [[edge of the battlefield|battlefield-edge]], each hit deals [[10%]]{atk} extra damage.
Increases damage per hit to [[45%]]{atk} and the ATK reduction to [[30%]].
Increases damage per hit to [[50%]]{atk} and the ATK reduction to [[30%]].
Increases damage per hit to [[55%]]{atk} and the ATK reduction to [[30%]].
Increases ATK by [[12%]] during battle.
Increases ATK by [[16%]] during battle.
Increases ATK by [[20%]] during battle.

Whenever Ride Down brings Estrilda to the enemy [[edge of the battlefield|battlefield-edge]], she plants a Pennon of Valor at her position for [[15]]s. Allies within 2 tiles of the Pennon gain [[30%]] ATK and take [[20%]] reduced damage.
Increases the ATK bonus granted to allies within the Pennon of Valor's range to [[35%]] and the damage reduction to [[22%]].
Estrilda marks any enemy she pushes to the enemy [[edge of the battlefield|battlefield-edge]] with Ride Down. Marked enemies take [[25%]] increased damage for [[15]]s.
Increases the ATK bonus granted to allies within the Pennon of Valor's range to [[40%]] and the damage reduction to [[24%]].

r.d: In Rivalry Mode, gains [[15]] Penetration and [[15]] Haste for [[5]]s when a battle starts and when [[assisting or defeating|assist-or-defeat]] an enemy.
Refine 4: In Rivalry Mode, increases 12 DEF Penetration, 20 Execution.

d: After Piercing Onslaught ends, Estrilda recovers [[300%]]{atk} HP and gains a [[300%]]{atk} shield. After Ride Down ends, she gains [[30]] Penetration and [[30%]] ATK for [[10]]s.
